files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Musescore v4.7.5 support
- Audio mixer between tracks

### Fixed

- Enable repeats
- Fix seeking glitch
- Fix wrong measure size
- Fix wrong sample rate (leading to incorrect pitch & speed)
